description.fallback: Mizuki is determined to make Naruto and Iruka suffer, and it appears like he has the upper edge with his improved strength and speed. Meanwhile, Ino, Chōji, and Shikamaru are at their limits, and now Fūjin and Raijin are free. That is until Tsunade shows up and defeats them both easily.
